newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ailing Spanish FM cannot work for three weeks.
newsitem.headline: Ailing Spanish FM cannot work for three weeks.

text.p: Spanish Foreign Minister Abel Matutes will not be able to work for at least three weeks after suffering a mild heart attack at the weekend, hospital officials said on Monday.

Matutes will remain in hospital for at least eight more days on the Mediterranean island of Ibiza where he was spending an Easter weekend holiday when he fell ill. He is expected to be released from the intensive care unit on Monday.
"We are not sure how long it will take him to recuperate ...It will be at least three weeks certainly," a manager at the hospital told Reuters.
The government has not named a replacement for Matutes during his absence from the foreign ministry.

A ministry spokeswoman said Secretary of State for Political Affairs Ramon de Miguel and Secretary of State for Cooperation and Latin America Fernando Villalonga will stand in for Matutes at previously scheduled events.
Villalonga will be the senior foreign ministry official representing Spain on a state visit to Mexico with Spanish King Juan Carlos and Queen Sofia scheduled to begin on Thursday.
Miguel will represent Matutes at a meeting with a U.S. delegation in Madrid on Tuesday to discuss a NATO summit to be held in Madrid in July on the possible inclusion of eastern European states.
He will also represent Matutes at a dinner with Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara on Tuesday evening, the ministry said.
